answer: 可以。如果你因医疗状况或其他特殊情况无法按时参加考试，可以申请延期。你需要尽快取得医生或校园健康服务中心出具的医疗证明（或认可的替代文件），申请截止时间为考试当天的晚上11:55。

points.text: 申请延期需要符合特殊情况，且是无法控制的原因导致无法在指定日期完成考试。
points.quote: You may be eligible to defer your scheduled final assessment (exam) if you couldn’t complete it on the set date due to exceptional circumstances beyond your control.
points.title: Defer or reschedule your scheduled final assessment (exam)

points.text: 缺考后应立即取得医疗证明或其他支持文件。
points.quote: you need to immediately get a medical certificate (or an approved alternative) from your doctor or a campus health service
points.title: Defer or reschedule your scheduled final assessment (exam)

points.text: 如果超过截止时间才提交申请，必须提供文件证明你因特殊情况无法按时申请，否则不予受理。
points.quote: We won’t accept an application for a deferred or rescheduled assessment after the deadline (11.55pm on its set date) unless you can show with supporting documents that exceptional circumstances beyond your control prevented you from applying on time
